mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_script ( id, script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, meeting_objective, previsit_summary, agenda_items, kyc_questions, product_discussions, risk_points, closing_summary, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{script.scriptId}, #{script.customerId}, #{script.rmId}, #{script.operatingCaseId}, #{script.journeyId}, #{script.meetingObjective}, #{script.previsitSummary}, #{script.agendaItems, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.AgendaItemListTypeHandler}, #{script.kycQuestions, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.KycQuestionItemListTypeHandler}, #{script.productDiscussions, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.ProductDiscussionItemListTypeHandler}, #{script.riskPoints, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.handler.StringListJsonTypeHandler}, #{script.closingSummary}, #{script.createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler}, #{script.createdAt, typeHandler=com.gien.gits.adapter.persistence.common.typehandler.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, meeting_objective, previsit_summary, agenda_items, kyc_questions, product_discussions, risk_points, closing_summary, created_at FROM meeting_script WHERE script_id = #{scriptId}

SELECT script_id, customer_id, rm_id, operating_case_id, journey_id, meeting_objective, previsit_summary, agenda_items, kyc_questions, product_discussions, risk_points, closing_summary, created_at FROM meeting_script WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
